description: This file implements API routes for managing shopping cart operations in a FastAPI application, including retrieving cart summary, adding, updating, removing, and clearing cart items, with database interactions via SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in a user's shopping cart.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item available for ordering.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enumeration of user roles, e.g., CUSTOMER.

classes.name: CartSummaryItem
classes.description: Schema for cart summary item details.

classes.name: CartSummaryResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response returned when retrieving the cart summary.

classes.name: CartAddItemRequest
classes.description: Schema for adding an item to the cart.

classes.name: CartItemResponse
classes.description: Schema for individual cart item response.

classes.name: CartUpdateItemRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating the quantity of a cart item.

classes.name: APIMessage
classes.description: Schema for generic API response message.

methods.name: Optional[int] _get_cart_restaurant_id(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the restaurant ID associated with current cart items for a user.

methods.name: Tuple[List[CartSummaryItem],Decimal,Optional[int]] _get_cart_summary(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Calculates the cart summary, total price, and restaurant ID for a user's cart.

methods.name: CartSummaryResponse get_cart( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current cart's contents and subtotal.

methods.name: CartItemResponse add_to_cart( payload: CartAddItemRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to add a menu item to the cart or increment its quantity.

methods.name: CartItemResponse update_cart_item( cart_item_id: int, payload: CartUpdateItemRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: APIMessage remove_cart_item( cart_item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to remove a specific item from the cart.

methods.name: APIMessage clear_cart( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to remove all items from the user's cart.

ctags.name: _get_cart_summary
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_cart_summary(db: Session, user_id: int) -> Tuple[List[CartSummaryItem], Decimal, Option/

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( cart_item_id: int, payload: CartUpdateItemRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
